sources.title: NVIDIA UJITSO Derived Data Cache System
sources.supported_fact: Local datastore cache location is configurable through /UJITSO/datastore/localCachePath. Cache misses normally build derived data. The documented forceBuilds option is not enabled by this candidate.

sources.title: NVIDIA Carbonite Kit Kernel Command Line Options
sources.supported_fact: --portable-root selects an isolated root for log, user data/config and cache, avoiding changes to the ordinary user profile.

sources.title: NVIDIA Kit Configuration
sources.supported_fact: Persistent configuration location is selected by /app/userConfigPath. The candidate binds it to a new own JSON file instead of the existing SDK user config.

sources.title: NVIDIA Omni Physics Settings
sources.supported_fact: Physics UJITSO cooking/remote cache/max-process settings are distinct controls. This candidate only reads them and requires their previous observed values, never changes them.
